detail.longDescription: Google's product launch events have always been a quirky grab-bag of Pixel phone updates and smartwatch announcements, with celebrity hosts like Trevor Noah doing their darndest to squeeze laughs out of teleprompter-reading Google product managers. But lately, there's been a new addition to these events: Google has begun spotlighting Gemini connections to apps like Wix, Zocdoc, and Ticketmaster.
